GOOD TO KNOW

Before you go

Pickup timePickup from your hotel in the afternoon. Our team sends the exact time on WhatsApp.
DurationAbout 6-7 hours in total, with drop-off back at your hotel.
Shared carsShared safari uses 4x4 cars with 7-8 guests. Seating is not guaranteed. For more comfort choose the private safari.
At the campGuests sit in a shared area, tables fill in order of arrival. Dinner is an open buffet, mostly Middle Eastern food.
What to wearThe desert can be cool in the evening, a light jacket is a good idea.
ATV and buggy onlyWithout the safari, hotel or home pickup and drop-off is 400 AED (110 USD) per booking.

QUESTIONS

Frequently asked

Is it safe?

Yes, our drivers drive in the desert every day. Safety equipment and a briefing are given for ATV and buggy.

Can children join?

Yes, children are welcome. Under 3 years free, 3 years and over 120 AED (33 USD).

Is the food halal?

Our team confirms the menu details on WhatsApp.

How do I pay?

Payment is arranged with our team on WhatsApp.

Can I cancel?

Cancellation rules are explained by our team on WhatsApp when you book.

Where are you?

We are in Dubai and pick you up from your hotel.
